sampleLimitation: 3 completed DAILY_EPISODE campaigns; fewer than 5 completed DAILY_EPISODE campaigns forces INSUFFICIENT_SAMPLE. Historical results are evidence for this frozen hypothesis only and do not authorize live trading.

liveWalletFeasibility.reason: Deterministic offline replay does not access live account state.

strategy.macroArm: Independently observe 1W and 2W %K or %D below 20, then a later bullish %K/%D cross; arm when both rebounds are confirmed and both %K are below 80.
strategy.dailyEntry: While armed, buy once per distinct closed-1D %K < 10 episode; rearm only after closed-1D %K >= 10.
strategy.macroExit: Close the whole campaign when latest completed 1W and 2W %K are both >= 80.
